description:
The French Country Chest measures 40 inches wide, 50 inches high, and 21½ inches deep.

Its dovetailed drawers have full-extension glides and come in two sizes, so small essentials and larger clothing each have a place. It is crafted from solid wood with the signature French Country detailing.
title: French Country Chest
metaDescription: French Country Chest: solid hardwood nursery furniture for your family.
